method: Joint bootstrap: for each of n_bootstrap_replicates case-level resamples of the *same* underlying vendored FROC bootstrap (np.random seed fixed before the run), evaluate the interpolated FROC curve at all 7 official FP/scan points, average those 7 values within the replicate, then take the 2.5th/97.5th percentile ACROSS replicates of that per-replicate average. This differs from (and is more correct than) averaging the 7 independently-computed marginal per-point CIs, because all 7 points on a given replicate are driven by the same resampled cases and are therefore highly correlated.
